title: Rheum–Derm Clinical Trials Evidence Dashboard
interpretiveBoundaries: A registered study is not evidence of positive efficacy.
Interventional trials, observational studies, extensions, regulatory events, development programs, and mechanistic studies must remain distinguishable.
Registration status, posted results, publication interpretation, and regulatory approval must not be conflated.
The dashboard is a research artifact and is not patient-specific clinical guidance.
nextRequiredRelease: Publish normalized source records and a data dictionary.
Add deterministic registry and publication refresh diffs.
Add adjudication status for ambiguous or duplicate records.
Provide a non-JavaScript searchable fallback and normalized data export.
